(async () => { const banned = ['Wi-Fi', 'WiFi', 'FTP', '热点', 'SSID', 'BLE', 'SDK', '退出码']; const seen = { offlineHint: false, banned: [] }; const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === '连接'); if (!button) throw Error('No 连接 button'); button.click(); const started = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - started < 120000) { const text = document.body.innerText; if (text.includes('暂时断开外网')) seen.offlineHint = true; for (const word of banned) if (text.includes(word) && !seen.banned.includes(word)) seen.banned.push(word); if (text.includes('已同步 3 条录音')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30)); } if (!document.body.innerText.includes('已同步 3 条录音')) throw Error('One click did not finish the sync: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (!seen.offlineHint) throw Error('The offline hint never appeared during the Wi-Fi transfer'); if (seen.banned.length) throw Error('Technical words leaked into the main view: ' + seen.banned.join(',')); return { ...seen, ms: Date.now() - started }; })()

(async () => { const d = (await (await fetch('/api/device', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json()).data; if (d.activity !== null || d.onDevice.length !== 0 || d.lastResult?.transport !== 'wifi' || d.lastResult?.done !== 3) throw Error('Unexpected device view: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); const list = (await (await fetch('/api/recordings', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json()).data.items; if (list.length !== 3 || list.some((item) => item.status !== 'ready' && item.status !== 'queued_transcribe')) throw Error('Unexpected recordings: ' + JSON.stringify(list.map((item) => item.status))); return { lastResult: d.lastResult, cleanable: d.cleanable, statuses: list.map((item) => item.status) }; })()

(() => { const section = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find((s) => s.querySelector('h3')?.innerText.trim() === '最近设备操作'); if (!section) throw Error('No device log section'); const rows = [...section.querySelectorAll('li.devlog__row:not(.devlog__head)')].map((tr) => tr.innerText); if (!rows.some((row) => row.includes('无线快传'))) throw Error('No 无线快传 entry in the device log: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); return rows.length; })()
